text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara managed to secure a spot in
the 
Arima Kinen, but... she ended up losing, 
just like always.

Though Haru Urara seemed to enjoy her
run, 
she muttered that it felt kind of strange.

To clear away those lingering, unsettled 
feelings... Haru Urara decided to aim for 
the Arima Kinen once again.
